scene: On steep terraces above a tile-roofed village in a long drought, round tired Uncle Shi pours a thin stream of tea from a battered steel thermos onto a bed of withered yellow straw-coloured rice seedlings, all the terraces around are parched pale yellow and brown with cracked dry ochre soil, curled brittle tea bushes, no green fields anywhere, Mei stands small and far away below on the path, wide shot, pale hazy mountains behind

Mei, Tao and Hua walk together up a narrow dirt path through a tall green bamboo forest with stripes of sunlight and mist, Old Grey the water buffalo walks beside them, Hua holds a folded paper map in her hands while Mei's hands are empty, wide shot seen from the side
